thread:
sophie - Support: Heads up — OpalHealth reporting repeated 429s from their Dedicated pool during PST afternoon peak. They say baseline ~120 qps, peaks ~850 qps for ~10m, and we're throttling at 700 qps. Msg attached from them.

mike - Eng-SRE: Can you paste their pool config and the 429 error body? Also include the autoscale logs if available. :thinking: 

sophie - Support: Error body: {"error":"rate_limited","detail":"pool capacity exceeded"} They sent sample timeline: 14:02-14:12 local. Pool name: opal-dedicated-us-west. Baseline qps they reported 120, typical 95th p90 latency 120ms before spike.

raj - Infra: grabbing metrics now. Querying GPU utilization + queue length. Will post graphs.

autoscale-bot: [info] pool=opal-dedicated-us-west desired_replicas=4 current_replicas=4 pending_scale_up=0

mike - Eng-SRE: If desired == current with spike still causing 429s it's either scale step/cooldown too slow, or noisy neighbor usage pushing util > threshold. What's our target utilization? We should be at 60-70% during baseline, allow burst to 85% before scaling.

elaine - Customer-Success: OpalHealth says they didn't change traffic pattern, this is new vs last week when similar spikes were fine. They also said they saw a surge of concurrent long-context generations (seq_len ~4096) which increases per-request GPU time.

sophie - Support: Repro steps from customer:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Pool: opal-dedicated-us-west" \
  -d '{"model":"llama-2-13b","input":"...","max_tokens":4000}'
Response:
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":12}

mike - Eng-SRE: Ok two angles: (A) immediate mitigation: bump reserved replicas for opal pool to 6 and enable short-term burst capacity. (B) root cause: check autoscale config: min_replicas, max_replicas, scale_step, cooldown, metric used (gpu_util vs queue_length). Also need to confirm our batching strategy + KV cache reuse: long-context leads to larger per-token time and less batching efficiency.

raj - Infra: Found that their autoscale policy had max_replicas=6 but scale_step=1 and cooldown=300s. During spike we needed +3 replicas fast. autoscale-bot log:
```
[14:03:22] metric=cpu_util=78 gpu_util=82 queue_len=23
[14:04:10] scale_decision: add 1 replica (cooldown) -> delayed
[14:05:33] queue_len=40
[14:06:00] 429s spike
```

mike - Eng-SRE: That's it. scale_step=1 + long cooldown = slow response. We should either increase scale_step to 2-3 for this pool or lower cooldown to 60s for customer pools with bursty traffic. Also consider burst_capacity setting.

elaine - Customer-Success: OpalHealth is asking for an SLA-friendly fix today. They want a recommended capacity plan. Can we propose baseline/peak + utilization target and cost impact?

sophie - Support: Proposed quick plan:
- Target baseline capacity for 120 qps -> X GPUs (we need perf numbers, estimate ~0.35 qps/GPU for seq_len 4k? need bench)
- Set min_replicas=4, max_replicas=10, scale_step=3, cooldown=60s
- Enable +2 burst replicas for 20m window
- Monitor 5m p95 latency and throttle only above 90% utilization

mike - Eng-SRE: I'll run a perf estimate. Rough calc: with their model and avg tokens per request, bench shows ~25 samples/s per GPU for short context; for 4k context it's ~4-6 samples/s. For peak 850 qps, if per-request generates ~1 sample, we need ~850/5=170 GPUs — that's obviously wrong. Wait recalc: qps vs samples/s confusion. Let's bench locally and return numbers. :face_with_thermometer: 

raj - Infra: Action items I'll take:
- temp scale up to 6 replicas now (autoscale-bot triggered)
- modify pool policy cooldown->60s and scale_step->3 as a canary
- enable burst_capacity +2 for 30m

autoscale-bot: [action] scaling opal-dedicated-us-west from 4 -> 6 replicas (initiated by raj)

sophie - Support: Thanks. I'll notify OpalHealth of temporary bump and schedule post-mortem with them tomorrow. :thumbsup: 

mike - Eng-SRE: Please collect perf traces (GPU times per request) and sample payloads (anonymized). We'll build a capacity plan: baseline qps -> required replicas at 70% target util, peak headroom for burst, and cost trade-offs.

elaine - Customer-Success: I'll own cost discussion and send pricing delta for +2 replicas. Keep me posted.

sophie - Support: Closing loop once metrics show stability. Last check-in in 30m.
